items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: But I did not understand the Lou Waters band at all, and it was hard for me to grasp.

ctx.x: Yeah, there were purists then, and I managed to stay -- although they bugged me, I managed to stay clear of them. But I did not understand the Lou Waters band at all, and it was hard for me to grasp.
That was the first imitating band, to imitate the King Oliver band. It was stupid, I think. And it's still going on.
